description: Java interface for image-related API operations in the Fineract client, including methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting images, and a utility for preparing image files as Data URLs.

classes.name: ImagesApi
classes.description: Feign client interface for /images API endpoints, including methods for create, get, update, delete, and a static utility method for preparing image files for upload.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Sends a POST request to upload an image as a Data URL for a specific entity type and ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves images for a specific entity type and ID, with optional query parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing image with a new Data URL for a specific entity type and ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an image for a specific entity type and ID.

methods.name: prepareFileUpload
methods.description: Static method that reads a file, detects its media type, encodes it in Base64, and returns a Data URL string.
